metadata.notes: A real DSH v3 turn produces model, token, and direct context-window fields; the live tailer computes a non-zero 3.01% context utilization.

assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## What this cell asserts

After one trivial DSH turn, the dashboard must show a non-unknown model, a positive context window, and positive context utilization. The session must follow `ready -> working -> ready` and finish ready.

## Agent support

DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 persists every input required by this scenario. A real successful v3 transcript contains `request/context.data.model = qwen/qwen3.5-9b` and `request/context.data.contextWindow = 262144`. Its first assistant record repeats model `qwen/qwen3.5-9b` and reports 7872 input tokens, 26 output tokens, and 7898 total tokens. The turn then ends with `reason.kind = completed`. The local Qwen model config independently declares `text_config.max_position_embeddings = 262144`. DSH therefore records an agent model label, a positive model window, and a positive token numerator after the first turn.

The interactive driver supplies these values through a per-run DSH patch. It selects provider `lmstudio`, model `qwen/qwen3.5-9b`, and `contextWindow = 262144`, then launches `dsh --profile tui --patch <patch>`. The measured durable record proves that DSH applied the patch.

## Daemon capability

The DSH adapter tails `session.vN.jsonl.zstd` through `FilesUnderRoot`. `parseRequestContext` maps the durable model directly into `ParsedEvent.ModelName` and the durable `contextWindow` integer into `ParsedEvent.ContextWindow`. `parseAssistantMessage` independently maps the assistant source model and its usage snapshot. `TranscriptTailer.applyModelMetadata` keeps the positive context value as its override. `ComputeContextUtilization` gives that direct override precedence over the capacity table and computes `totalTokens / contextWindow * 100`.

A one-shot tailer probe over the real transcript produced `model="qwen/qwen3.5-9b" total=7898 window=262144 utilization=3.012847900 unknown=false last="turn_done"`. This directly proves all three live metric assertions. The existing compressed-transcript end-to-end test also asserts model `qwen/qwen3.5-9b`, total tokens, context window `262144`, `ContextWindowUnknown == false`, and terminal `turn_done`. The daemon can therefore show the complete live model/context vector without a capacity-table lookup.

## Offline replay assertions

The replay summary exports DSH's direct `TotalTokens`, `ContextWindow`, and `ContextUtilization` values when the transcript reports positive total tokens. The observation spec requires all three values to be positive. Transcript assertions also pin the exact request model and 262144-token context window. These checks verify the recorded metric vector without a manual dashboard inspection.

## Driver capability

The recipe needs `send`, `wait_turn`, and `sleep`. The DSH driver declares and implements each step. It uses a fresh cwd and a pre-launch marker to select the new transcript. `wait_turn` polls the durable transcript for a completed `turn/end`. The recipe uses a 20-second trailing sleep, matching the longest sibling recipe for this scenario. It uses a 300-second timeout because the measured local qwen turn took 157.8 seconds from request header to assistant message.

## Result

The recorded cell verifies the exact model and positive context vector through its replay golden and transcript assertions.
caveats: The observation spec requires positive total tokens, context window, and context utilization. Transcript assertions independently pin the exact request model and 262144-token context window.

Load-bearing environment precondition: LM Studio must answer at http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 and expose qwen/qwen3.5-9b. Re-probe this at record time. A different model would invalidate the exact model assertion and could change the declared context window.

The dashboard reflects DSH's transcript-declared model capacity of 262144. At assessment time, LM Studio reported the model's maxContextLength as 262144 but its current local allocation as contextLength 4096. This does not violate the scenario's non-zero acceptance criteria, but the two values must not be described as the same runtime limit.
Load-bearing isolation precondition: the driver must retain its fresh per-run cwd and pre-launch marker. Otherwise an unrelated DSH transcript could satisfy the lifecycle and model observations.
The measured local turn took 157.8 seconds. This recipe uses 300 seconds because a 120-180 second budget does not provide safe headroom.

sources.note: Produced model=qwen/qwen3.5-9b, TotalTokens=7898, ContextWindow=262144, ContextUtilization=3.012847900, ContextWindowUnknown=false, LastEventType=turn_done.
parseRequestContext maps data.model and data.contextWindow directly; parseAssistantMessage maps source.model and the usage snapshot; completed turn/end maps to turn_done.
TestParserMapsMeasuredRequestContext and TestZstdTranscriptEndToEnd assert the direct model/window fields, token totals, ContextWindowUnknown false, and terminal lifecycle through compressed input.
applyModelMetadata retains the adapter context-window override. ComputeContextUtilization gives the override precedence and computes positive utilization from TotalTokens.
The replay summary and observation verifier export context fields only for antigravity. DSH golden replay therefore exposes model and cumulative tokens but not its correct live context vector.
Creates the per-run model/context patch, isolates transcript discovery by marker and cwd, and implements send, wait_turn, and sleep.

preconditions: dsh >=0.1.5-rc.2 is installed and on PATH
the community TUI profile is installed under ~/.dsh/profiles/tui
re-probe at record time that LM Studio answers at http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 and exposes qwen/qwen3.5-9b
irrlichd is recording the deepseek-harness adapter
setup: The interactive driver creates a fresh cwd and a pre-launch transcript marker.
The driver applies a temporary patch for LM Studio, qwen/qwen3.5-9b, and context window 262144 without modifying the installed profile.
The replay golden and observation assertions verify the DSH context window and utilization.
verify: the same DSH session follows ready -> working -> ready and ends ready
after turn_done, live metrics.model_name is qwen/qwen3.5-9b and is not unknown
after turn_done, live metrics.context_window is 262144 and ContextWindowUnknown is false
after turn_done, live metrics.context_utilization_percentage is greater than zero
the replay golden reports model qwen/qwen3.5-9b, a 262144-token context window, and positive token use and context utilization
the durable transcript contains no tool/call record for the exact-number prompt
recipe.scope_note: Uses the scenario's longest sibling settle delay, 20 seconds. Uses a 300-second timeout because the measured local qwen turn took 157.8 seconds.
